pages.title: Cave Maze
pages.creator: Fzgames
pages.description:
Explore a dark cave by torchlight in Cave Maze. Search for keys and embers, avoid the spirit wandering through the shadows, and cross crumbling bridges on your way to the exit. The timer and your remaining fuel limit how long you can spend finding a route.

Move with the arrow keys, or use swipe and tap controls. Coins earned during play can unlock different flame colors, adding a visual reward to your maze exploration.

pages.title: Monster School 2
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description:
Monster School 2 follows a class of Minecraft monsters through their teacher's tests. Try bottle-flip challenges, parkour courses, and roller-coaster activities as the students attempt to show their skills.

Click the left mouse button to begin a test and work through the school's different challenges.

pages.title: Mr Long Legs
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description:
Mr Long Legs is a physics puzzle about guiding a long-legged stickman across difficult terrain. Tap to stretch his legs, balance through the route, and avoid the obstacles and traps in his path.

The settings include mountains, city routes, and slippery ice. Each step asks you to manage the character's unusual proportions while keeping him upright and moving forward.

pages.title: Dog Escape
pages.creator: Sunday GmbH
pages.description:
Dog Escape combines hide-and-seek rescues with puppy care. Swipe or drag to guide a dog to the green exit while avoiding guards, lasers, and traps. Hide inside closets or use plant disguises when a route becomes dangerous.

Room objects provide other ways forward. Buttons can shut down traps, portals move the dog elsewhere, and puppy food lets it break through walls. Once the dog is home, you can feed, cuddle, and style it, linking the escape puzzles with looking after the rescued puppy.

pages.title: Eastern Star vs City Style Icon
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description:
Eastern Star vs City Style Icon pairs a heroine in Ottoman-inspired fantasy outfits with a modern city fashionista. Create a look for each character by choosing clothes, makeup, hairstyles, and accessories.

Mix influences from fairy-tale fashion and contemporary glamour as you put the outfits together. At the end, you can save the looks you like as PNG images.

pages.title: Duck Luck
pages.creator: BlackMoon Design
pages.description:
Duck Luck is a number-merging puzzle where you position a duck to drop numbered blocks. When identical numbers touch, they combine into a larger value and help clear space on the board. Build bigger numbers and collect points as you aim for a higher score.

Use the left and right arrows or swipe sideways to position the duck. Press Down or swipe downward to drop the next tile.

pages.title: Image Crossword
pages.creator: Ultra Games Entertainment Private limited
pages.description:
Image Crossword is a word puzzle where pictures become letters. Use the visual cues to work out how those letters fit into words, bringing image recognition into the crossword grid.

Click and drag with the mouse to interact with the puzzle.

pages.title: Dots Master
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Dots Master is a puzzle game about connecting matching dots within a limited number of moves. Drag through dots horizontally or vertically, and form a square or loop to clear dots of the same color in one move.

Level goals vary: you may need to collect particular colored dots, pop stars, create loops, or conquer tiles. Work through five chapters of puzzles, checking the current objective before deciding which connections to make.

pages.title: Domino Online Multiplayer
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Domino Online Multiplayer is a tile-matching game where players take turns extending a chain. Place a domino so its number matches the tile beside it; if you cannot play, draw from the market until you find a suitable piece. Each player starts with seven tiles, and the first to empty their hand wins.

Choose an AI opponent with adjustable difficulty, join a live online duel, or send a link to play with a friend remotely. A shared-screen option also lets two people play on one device.

pages.title: Bubble Game 3D
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description:
Bubble Game 3D is a bubble shooter where you aim an arrow and click to send a bubble into the board. Match at least three bubbles of one color to remove them, and clear the layout before the bubbles reach the bottom.

Shots can bounce off the walls to reach difficult angles. Plan those bounces and look for combinations that clear more bubbles as you work through the board.

pages.title: Luna And The Magic Maze
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Luna And The Magic Maze follows a small creature who dreams of becoming a wizard despite having no natural magic. Guide Luna through mazes in an autumn forest, collecting magical artifacts, unlocking gates, and using teleportation portals to complete each level.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys. The mazes become more challenging as you progress.

pages.title: Idle Supermarket Tycoon
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description:
Idle Supermarket Tycoon asks you to develop a shopping mall by opening stores and improving their interiors. Serve customers and build the mall's reputation as you decide where to invest in its expansion.

Assign priority shoppers, use delivery vehicles to earn additional income, and complete missions for rewards. Left-click the interface to manage the business, and use the plus and minus keys to adjust the camera view.

pages.title: Money ping pong
pages.creator: MemorySharp
pages.description:
Money ping pong is an idle game built around arranging blocks and bouncing balls. Place money blocks on the field to narrow the space the balls can travel through and speed up your earnings.

Spend money on upgrades to finish levels, with different maps and functional block types changing the layouts you can build.

pages.title: Volley Bean
pages.creator: batpad
pages.description:
Volley Bean is a volleyball game with quick matches and randomly appearing boosts. Move and jump with W, A, and D or the arrow keys, positioning your bean player for the next exchange.

While airborne, the red player can dunk with G and the blue player with K. The first side to reach eleven points wins, making each rally count toward the match score.

pages.title: ASMR Beauty Homeless
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description:
ASMR Beauty Homeless combines a hygiene-care sequence with a makeover for Anna. Help the doctor clean her body and teeth, then care for the area around her piercing before moving on to styling.

Once the treatment is finished, choose an outfit for Anna. Use the mouse to interact with the game as you work through the care and dressing activities.

pages.title: Golf Orbit
pages.creator: TapNation
pages.description:
Golf Orbit is a one-button golf game about sending the ball as far as possible. Time a left mouse click to set the power of your swing, then watch the shot travel. Objects along the route can give the ball extra bounces and add to its distance.

The game records the distance of each shot, giving you a result to improve with the next swing.

pages.title: Tank Battle.io
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description:
Tank Battle.io combines tank combat with weapon development. Choose a tank, complete missions, and combine weapons while steering around obstacles and resisting fire from enemy tanks. Finishing assigned tasks also unlocks more tanks.

The available level modes offer different difficulties, and higher levels increase the income you receive. On a computer, move with WASD and click the red icon to shoot; the mobile controls use a virtual joystick for navigating the map.

pages.title: Pin Master
pages.creator: Mamboo Games
pages.description:
Pin Master is a screw puzzle about releasing metal plates in the right order. Tap to unlock screw holes and let the plates fall, working out which parts of the arrangement need to be freed first.

More than one hundred stages give you different combinations of nuts, bolts, and plates to solve. If you get stuck, the game provides hints and an option to remove random screws.

pages.title: Moto Cabbie Simulator
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description:
Moto Cabbie Simulator puts you on a motorcycle taxi in a city setting. Ride through the streets using WASD or the arrow keys, with Space handling the brake.

The motorcycle also has turn indicators and a headlight. Q activates the left indicator, E activates the right, and L controls the light as you navigate the city.

pages.title: Deform It
pages.creator: NCY
pages.description:
Deform It lets you fire projectiles at objects to alter their shapes in a space setting. Choose from thirteen ball options and move the camera to line up your shots. The game includes fourteen levels, plus Free Deform and Antigravity modes alongside Level Mode.

Use WASD to move the camera, Q and E to change its height, and the left mouse button to shoot. Double-shot, triple-shot, and multishot skills are assigned to F, G, and H, giving you different firing options while deforming the objects.

pages.title: Fishing For Gold
pages.creator: ravel
pages.description:
Fishing For Gold is about using fishing earnings to reach a treasure hidden deep below. Catch fish to make money, then spend it on improving your fishing rod so you can reach farther down.

Play with the arrow keys, WASD, or touch controls.

pages.title: Pool Float Party
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description:
Help Blondie and Marie prepare a poolside celebration in Pool Float Party. Clean and repair the pool, organize the surrounding area, and make cocktails before turning to the friends' party looks.

Apply makeup, choose outfits and accessories, and pick inflatable floats in different shapes. Use mouse clicks or touchscreen taps to interact with the game.

pages.title: Toy Shooter
pages.creator: Xenolia
pages.description:
Toy Shooter turns your room into a survival battle against toys that have begun attacking you. Move around the room and shoot the invading toys, dealing with the different kinds that come after you.

Use the arrow keys to move and the mouse to fire.

pages.title: Beach Run
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description:
Beach Run combines running, shooting, and gathering a group for a final fight. Fire to free your friends and add them to your party as you move along the course. If a barrier cannot be completely destroyed, steer clear of it.

The run ends with a battle against an enemy. You can also unlock character skins with gold, giving you different appearances to choose from for later runs.

pages.title: Dream Pet Link 2
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description:
Dream Pet Link 2 is an animal-tile puzzle where you link identical pairs to remove them. Clear the whole play area before time expires, searching for matching animals among the remaining tiles.

Choose between two difficulty modes. Easy mode uses fewer tiles and supplies more hints, while hard mode offers a tougher board.

pages.title: Nextbot: Can You Escape?
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description:
Nextbot: Can You Escape? traps you in a world where fast-moving pursuers chase you. Survive for the required amount of time and escape, keeping away from the nextbots because close contact is fatal.

Look around with the mouse and move with WASD. F lets you interact or hide, while T brings you out of hiding.

pages.title: Space Conflict
pages.creator: GameEon Studios
pages.description:
Space Conflict puts you in command of a spaceship defending against incoming meteors. Fire the ship's cannons to destroy them before they reach you, moving around the danger as you shoot.

On a keyboard, use Up, Left, and Right to move and Space to fire. Touchscreen controls provide a joystick and a fire button for the same movement-and-shooting task.

pages.title: Merge And Invade
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: In Merge And Invade, you are an aspiring king building an army at a new castle. Begin by collecting soldiers and purchasing your first barracks. Use the joystick to control your character as you gather the forces needed to establish your army.

pages.title: Hovercraft Spaceship
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description:
Hovercraft Spaceship sends you through space courses filled with rings, obstacles, and pickups. Steer through the rings, keep clear of hazards, and gather gold along with weapon items and magnet bonuses.

Spend the gold in the shop to buy spacecraft from a selection of twenty-one vehicles. Daily bonuses provide another source of gold. Use WASD, the arrow keys, or mouse and touch swipes to guide your craft through the levels.

pages.title: Happy Farm Harvest Blast
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Happy Farm Harvest Blast makes harvesting a garden into a ball-shooting challenge. Fire balls at the crop parcels to collect the produce, working toward gathering all the fruit and vegetables in each level.

The harvest includes tomatoes, mushrooms, potatoes, carrots, and onions. As the levels become more demanding, bonuses and other helpful extras become available to assist with clearing the garden.

pages.title: Brain Test
pages.creator: AppyApp
pages.description: Brain Test presents logic puzzles that call for close attention to details and approaches beyond the obvious answer. Work through the different challenges, changing your approach when the usual solution does not work. If you run out of ideas, use a clue to help with the current puzzle.

pages.title: FreegearZ
pages.creator: David Jalbert
pages.description:
Enter the Freegear Tournament as a new racer in FreegearZ. Compete in four tournaments, each made up of four races on abandoned highways in different parts of the world.

Steer with the arrow keys and hold C to activate the turbo boost.

pages.title: Super Brothers
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Super Brothers is a 2D puzzle-platform adventure about helping two brothers escape a dangerous fantasy world. Collect keys, open doors, and switch between the characters to get through water hazards, spikes, and other obstacles on the way home.

Use WASD to move and Space to change characters. On a touchscreen, use the on-screen buttons. Deciding which brother should tackle the next part of the route is part of solving each level.

pages.title: Titan Swamp Attack
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description:
Fight through a swamp occupied by monsters and robots in Titan Swamp Attack. A hostile boss has taken over the area and threatens the world, and you control a small titan sent to stop the attack.

On a computer, use the arrow keys to move and jump, and the mouse to attack and shoot. Touchscreen players use the game buttons. Combine movement with attacks as you work through the enemies in the swamp.

pages.title: Real Flight Simulator 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Real Flight Simulator 3D lets you pilot a plane above mountain and river landscapes. Control the aircraft with mouse clicks and the arrow keys, or use touch input.

pages.title: Correct Math
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Correct Math tests addition and subtraction with short multiple-choice questions. Read the calculation and choose its correct result from three possible answers before your thinking time runs out.

Tap the answer you want to select. The aim is to earn as many points as possible, combining quick calculations with accurate choices as the questions continue.

pages.title: Survive In The Forest
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description:
Survive In The Forest starts you with an axe and the trees around you. Cut trees and use them to build a shelter, working toward surviving in the forest. The game offers daytime and nighttime locations.

Move with WASD, jump with Space, and run with Shift. The left mouse button handles cutting and building, while E picks things up and R drops them. Gathering and working with the available materials is central to establishing your shelter.

pages.title: Stickman Dash
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Stickman Dash puts a sword-wielding ninja against a group of criminals. Drag to control the action and use rebounds from walls to avoid enemy attacks while taking on your targets.

Your sword can be improved as you play.

pages.title: Fast Ninja
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Fast Ninja challenges you to keep a ninja running while collecting coins, gold, and jewels. Jumps, thorns, and bombs make the route dangerous, so watch for hazards as you pursue the pickups.

Use the mouse or tap the screen to play. The goal is to extend your run and collect as much treasure as possible without letting the obstacles stop you.

pages.title: Cube Surfer
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Cube Surfer is a 3D running game about reaching the end of an obstacle-filled track. Slide on the screen to guide the runner around hazards and toward the finish.

Cubes on the course can be stacked together as you jump. Moving through the track involves both building that stack and choosing a route past the dangers, with more levels to attempt as you progress.

pages.title: Two Tubes 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Two Tubes 3D takes you through an endless tunnel filled with triangular obstacles. Keep moving without hitting the hazards and try to cover the longest distance you can.

Choose one-player mode or play with a second person. The keyboard controls use A and D together with the Left and Right arrow keys, letting you test your reactions alone or compete with a friend.

pages.title: Bowling
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Bowling is a score-based bowling game for one player or two friends. Use the left mouse button to take your shots and try to achieve the highest score.

pages.title: Break Free Space Station
pages.creator: playit-online
pages.description: Break Free Space Station is an escape game about waking up trapped on a space station even though you are not an astronaut. Explore your surroundings and work out how to get out. Use the mouse to pick up items as you investigate the station and look for a way to leave.

pages.title: Triangle Wars
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Pilot a lone spaceship in Triangle Wars, an endless space shooter about surviving attacks and building a high score. Fight other ships and face boss vessels as you try to keep your craft alive.

Power-ups include bombs, splash bullets, and extra lives, giving you different kinds of help during the battle. An interactive tutorial is available to help you learn the game.

pages.title: Quiet Boy Escape
pages.creator: games2mad
pages.description:
Quiet Boy Escape puts you in the role of a babysitter who arrives at a boy's home and finds him trapped inside. Search the house for hidden objects and use the clues you uncover to help him escape.

Play by pointing and clicking with the mouse, examining the surroundings and connecting the discovered objects with the house's puzzles.

pages.title: Save The Ball
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Save The Ball challenges you to keep a ball away from spikes along the bottom and walls of its playing area. Tap the screen or use the mouse to control it, staying clear of the dangerous edges. The aim is to survive as long as possible and improve your score.

pages.title: Supra Drift 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Supra Drift 2 lets you take a Toyota Supra through four driving locations, including a city, off-road terrain, a port, and a dockyard. Practice drifting in the different settings while controlling the car's direction and slides.

Drive with WASD or the arrow keys. Space applies the handbrake, F activates nitro, and G slows time. These controls let you combine steering, braking, and speed changes as you move through the locations.

pages.title: Mountain Man Climbing
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Mountain Man Climbing is a jumping game about crossing a series of hills without falling. Choose jumps that carry you over one hill or two at a time, watching the gaps before moving onward.

Collect watches along the route to gain extra time. Falling from the hills ends the game, so the challenge is to keep advancing while making each landing safely. Use the mouse to play.

pages.title: Sky Ski
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Sky Ski sends you sliding through a snowy setting with trees and rocks in your path. Steer clear of both kinds of obstacle as you ski. Hitting one ends the run and sends you back to the start.

pages.title: Monster Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Monster Trucks Jigsaw offers five truck pictures to rebuild from separate pieces. Select an image, then choose a puzzle with 25, 49, or 100 pieces.

Drag the fragments with the mouse or your finger and fit them into their proper positions to reconstruct the monster truck scene. Changing the piece count lets you assemble the same image in a simpler or more detailed form.

pages.title: Valentine Monster Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description:
Valentine Monster Memory is a tile-matching game with four levels of Valentine-themed monsters. Flip the squares and look for pairs with the same picture, continuing until every monster is matched.

The aim is to clear each board using as few moves as possible. Remember where the pictures appear so you can select a known pair when its partner turns up. Click or tap to reveal tiles.

pages.title: Doggy Jigsaw
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Doggy Jigsaw is a picture-assembly puzzle controlled with the mouse. Select a puzzle and drag its separate pieces into the correct positions, using the image fragments to work out where they belong. Complete the picture by arranging all its parts.

pages.title: Super Ball Blast
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Super Ball Blast puts you in charge of a cannon with balls to shoot. Fire at the visible targets and upgrade your cannon as you play. Use mouse or touch controls and try to keep surviving for longer.

pages.title: Fly Car Stunt 4
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
Fly Car Stunt 4 is a driving game with cars you can control in the air. Complete levels to receive new vehicles, choose from five flying-car models, and use the market and upgrade system to develop more powerful cars.

Two players have separate keyboard controls. Player one drives with the arrow keys and uses N for nitro, while player two drives with WASD and uses T for nitro. B and C provide their respective rear views, and R restarts a level.

pages.title: Clash of Blocks 2
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description:
Clash of Blocks 2 is a territory puzzle in which your starting placement determines how your color spreads across the board. Use the mouse to position your block, aiming to expand faster than the competing colors.

The goal is to claim a majority of the board. Consider the starting position before placing your block, then see how much space your color occupies.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzles Classic
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Jigsaw Puzzles Classic is a picture-puzzle collection with categories including animals, architecture, art, and nature. Choose a subject and rebuild its image by finding the pieces that fit each part of the scene.

pages.title: Mercedes Benz GLC63 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Mercedes Benz GLC63 Puzzle is a jigsaw collection featuring six pictures of the GLC63. Choose an image and reconstruct it by placing its separate pieces into the completed picture.

Each image offers four piece counts: 16, 36, 64, and 100. Use the mouse to play, selecting a smaller layout for fewer pieces or a larger one for a more detailed assembly task.

pages.title: Taleans Hansel & Gretel
pages.creator: The Ardents
pages.description:
Taleans Hansel & Gretel combines a fairy-tale adventure with sliding-path puzzles. Hansel and Gretel are trapped in a dark forest, and you need to help them find a route home.

Swipe the tiles to rearrange the paths, joining their sections so the characters can travel through the scene. On a computer, click and swipe with the mouse; touchscreen players swipe directly on the board.

pages.title: EG RoBoTex
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description:
EG RoBoTex is a robot-picture puzzle in which you restore missing sections of mechanical characters. Drag the separate pieces onto the matching silhouettes in the robot image, using their shapes to work out where they belong.

Completing the missing sections finishes the picture and opens the way to another robot puzzle. Use the mouse or touch controls to place the parts.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Newborn Vaccination
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description:
Help Hazel prepare her little brother Matt for a hospital visit in Baby Hazel Newborn Vaccination. Matt has a vaccination appointment, and Hazel is worried because she has not seen him get vaccinated before.

Use the mouse to interact with the siblings, get Matt ready in time for the appointment, and help Hazel comfort him during the visit.

pages.title: Kids Zoo Fun
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Kids Zoo Fun is a jigsaw game featuring animals in different scenes. Fit the separate pieces together to rebuild each animal picture.

There are three difficulty settings, with more pieces at the higher settings. This lets you choose how much assembly each picture requires. Settings and instructions sit behind a simple parental lock.

pages.title: Happy Hour
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Happy Hour is a drawing puzzle where you guide a drink into a martini glass. Draw shapes that become objects in the scene, then use them to control the liquid's flow and fill the glass.

The game has 120 levels set around its bar and nightlife theme. Each challenge gives you space to work out your own drawn solution, making the shape and position of your drawing central to getting the drink into the glass.

pages.title: Pencil True Colors
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description:
Pencil True Colors is a timed color-recognition game. Look at the colored pencil and its displayed color name, then choose Yes if they agree or No if they do not.

Use the mouse or tap the answer buttons. Try to make as many correct judgments as possible before time runs out, checking the pencil against the name each time a new combination appears.

pages.title: Grammys Award
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description:
Grammys Award is a makeover game about preparing Princess Princy and Princess Vincy for an awards show. Choose makeup and outfits for the two invited guests, putting together their looks for the event.

Use the mouse to make your selections and coordinate the clothing with the makeup you choose for each princess.

pages.title: Candy Monster Match 3
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Candy Monster Match 3 is a gem-matching puzzle where you swap neighboring tiles to form lines of at least three matching colors. Completed lines disappear from the board and add to your score.

Larger combinations award more points and produce special jewels, giving you a reason to look beyond the smallest available match. Use the mouse or touchscreen to play.

pages.title: Solitaire Legend
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Solitaire Legend is a single-player card puzzle with the goal of moving every card into the foundation piles. Take cards from the waste and tableau and build each foundation in ascending order.

Start a pile with an ace, then continue in the same suit through the numbered cards, jack, queen, and king. Completing those suit-by-suit sequences is how you finish the game.

pages.title: EG Police vs Thief
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description:
EG Police vs Thief puts you in control of a red car trying to escape a police car. Click or tap to change direction, timing the change to keep the chase going.

The game gradually speeds up, so the same direction-switching action requires quicker decisions as you continue avoiding the police.

pages.title: Cheesy Run
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Cheesy Run is an endless chase about protecting the cheese while escaping from a cat. Keep the run going and stop the pursuing cat from catching up with your cheese.

pages.title: 2D Car Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description:
2D Car Racing combines racing with power-ups, including nitrous boosts, maces, and missiles. Compete on the tracks, earn coins from races, and spend them to unlock different cars.

Two players can share a keyboard. Player one drives with WASD and uses T for power-ups, while player two drives with the arrow keys and activates power-ups with P. The weapons and boosts add another part to the race alongside steering.

pages.title: Toys Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Toys Coloring Book lets you choose a picture and paint it with your own colors. Select the image you want to work on, pick a color with the brush, and use it to fill the drawing. Your choices determine the finished color scheme for the selected picture.

pages.title: Strike Galaxy Attack
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Strike Galaxy Attack puts your spaceship up against an alien squadron in a survival battle. Guide the ship through the attack and collect dropped items that transform it into a more powerful form. Your objective is to keep the ship alive for as long as possible.

pages.title: Football Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Football Coloring Book lets you choose a football-themed picture and create its color scheme. Select a color for the brush and apply it to the image, changing colors as you work through the drawing.

pages.title: Hanger HTML5
pages.creator: A Small Game
pages.description:
Hanger HTML5 is a ragdoll physics game about swinging as far as possible. Press to fire a rope and release to let go, using speed and momentum to carry the character onward.

Watch for buzz saws and try to keep the ragdoll from losing too many body parts. Coins collected during the run unlock additional characters, giving you something to collect while extending your distance.

pages.title: Bonnie Galaxy Faces
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Bonnie Galaxy Faces is a festival makeover game built around colorful galaxy makeup. Choose a face design, blend its colors, then add eyeliner, mascara, and lipstick. Follow the makeup with a galaxy hairstyle and its color choices.

Finish the look with clothing, choosing a dress or combining tops, bottoms, boots, and outer layers. The game takes Bonnie from practicing face designs to putting together the rest of her festival outfit.

pages.title: c4arena
pages.creator: Daniel Vyskoc
pages.description:
c4arena is a Four-in-a-Row board game where the goal is to make a line of four. Plan your placements while watching the opponent's pieces and the lines they could complete.

Choose an online match, a local game with a friend, or a game against the computer. The same line-building objective applies across the different ways to play.

pages.title: Mexico Rex
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Mexico Rex puts you in control of Rex during a destructive trip through Mexico. Move with the keyboard, aim with the mouse, and fire the dinosaur's minigun at vehicles. Rex can also eat humans as he tears through the surroundings. The objective is to cause destruction with both the dinosaur and its weapon.

pages.title: Bartender
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Bartender is a pouring skill game where you control a bottle and try to earn a high score. The amount poured is measured in milliliters, and changing the bottle's angle changes the flow. Manage the pour while watching the amount in the glass.

pages.title: Loving Toads
pages.creator: Cosmity
pages.description:
Loving Toads is a retro jumping game where you time a toad's leap so it lands on the female toad below. Each successful landing earns a heart.

Collect hearts to unlock other toads, including alien and dragon versions. Once a species is available, you can switch to it while the toad is jumping.

pages.title: NMAliens
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description:
NMAliens puts you at the entrance to a party reserved for humans. Decide whether to admit or reject each arriving character, letting humans through and keeping aliens out.

Correct decisions add points, while admitting an alien or rejecting a human costs health and can reduce your score. The pixel-art game uses simple touch controls, so the challenge is recognizing each guest and choosing the right response.

pages.title: Princess Fashion Obsession
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Princess Fashion Obsession follows Belle and Ariel as they refresh their wardrobes through online shopping. Help the princesses browse clothes on a laptop and use their webcams to try items on. Click to see how a choice fits before continuing their fashion shopping.

pages.title: Princess Outfit Creator
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Outfit Creator is a dress-up game where you put together outfits for a princess. Choose from the available clothes and fashion items, combining pieces to create different looks for the same character.

pages.title: My Dolphin Show 5
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: My Dolphin Show 5 lets you control a dolphin performing for a waiting audience. Move with the arrow keys, swim around the pool, and line up jumps through the hoops. The challenge is guiding the dolphin into position and timing its movement to complete the show's tricks.

pages.title: Ladybug Baby Shower Care
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Ladybug Baby Shower Care combines baby-care activities with dressing a young superhero. Give Baby Ladybug a shower and offer her toys during bath time, then change her diaper and dry her hair.

After the care routine, choose tops, bottoms, and shoes to put together an outfit. Tap the game's items to work through the different activities, moving from washing and drying to matching her clothes.
